versions.content: Conversion functions for hexadecimal and binary values. Type: Valid Description: Logging shall provide the possibility for applications to convert decimal values into the hexadecimal or binary system. Rationale: Provide some debug information as a hexadecimal or as a binary value, instead of a decimal value. Use Case: Providing logging information as hexadecimal value or as binary value. Applies to: FO Dependencies: -- Supporting Material: --
